# LongHome

> Open-source, self-hosted software for permanent, family-stewarded memorial pages.

LongHome gives one person one lasting page. A memorial requires a name and at least one
photo. Birth and end dates, a written story, and videos are optional. The current product
is self-hosted only; managed hosting is explicitly deferred.

## Repository map

- `README.md`: user-facing overview and self-hosting instructions
- `docs/PRODUCT.md`: product boundary and ethical guardrails
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: development workflow and commit rules
- `SECURITY.md`: private vulnerability reporting policy
- `src/app.ts`: HTTP routes, upload validation, and rendered page composition
- `src/store.ts`: SQLite schema and persistence boundary
- `src/views/`: server-rendered EJS pages
- `src/public/styles.css`: visual system
- `src/app.test.ts`: HTTP-level behavior tests
- `Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yml`: self-hosting path

## Commands

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
npm test
npm run typecheck
npm run build
docker compose up --build
```

Node.js 22 or newer is required. Runtime data lives under `LONGHOME_DATA_DIR` (default
`./data`) and consists of `longhome.sqlite` plus `media/`. Preserve both together.

## Non-negotiable boundaries

- LongHome is founder-owned and independent from the Cogito product stack.
- No Cogito, cogitod, proprietary cloud, or managed-service dependency belongs here.
- Self-hosting and portable data are first-class product behavior.
- A memorial must have a name and at least one photo; every other biographical field is
  optional.
- Families preserve a person; the software must not impersonate one.
- Never add AI simulation of a deceased person without a new, explicit project decision.
- Never use real private memorial data in fixtures, examples, screenshots, or tests.

## Change expectations

Use Conventional Commits. Keep pull requests narrow. Behavior changes need tests. Public
contract changes need matching updates to README or product docs. Schema changes must
preserve existing installations and include a migration path.
